description:
Discover two of NYC's most picturesque neighborhoods: Brooklyn Heights & DUMBO, in one epic tour! Appreciate the legacy of beautiful Brooklyn Heights in the fight for liberty, social justice and unity and enjoy the art, culture and views of DUMBO. This experience is great for singles, couples, families, and team building!

Some of the highlights include:

- Impressive architecture & history in America's 1st suburb
- The role Brooklyn played in American Independence
- The Brooklyn Heights Promenade with amazing, sweeping views of NY Harbor and Manhattan's skyline!
- Plymouth Church, "Grand Central Terminal" of the Underground Railroad that helped runaway slaves escape
- Learn about influential people who called Brooklyn Heights home, past and present.
- Brooklyn Bridge Park, one of the most beautiful in NYC
- DUMBO secrets and street art
- Iconic view and photo spot of the Manhattan Bridge
- The epic story of the Brooklyn Bridge and the extraordinary woman behind it.

There will be many sweet photo opportunities on this tour and I am a skilled photographer, happy to capture some unforgettable pictures of you :) I want this experience to be one of the highlights of your NYC visit. Appreciate the beauty and history of the Heights, the sights of DUMBO, make new friends and fall in love with Brooklyn!
hostdescription:
I love Brooklyn for the cultural diversity, creative energy and chill vibes. It is a joy to share the art, culture, food and history of the best borough as a licensed NYC guide.

My goal is to give you an unforgettable experience; as delightful as it is insightful. I want this to be the highlight of your NYC visit!

And if you would like tips to help plan your NY trip, or info about other specialty tours I give, please send me a message. I am always happy to help!

"Spread Love, it's the Brooklyn way" - The Notorious B.I.G.
